facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT's National Cybersecurity Strategy 2023-2026, the successor to the 2014-2019 strategy, sets four pillars; it prints only the year, so as_of is the document's published year.

The strategy states the National Cybersecurity Committee, with 13 members, is the governance body set up under the Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Act 2021 (proclaimed December 2021) to coordinate the strategy and the critical information infrastructure protection framework.
The strategy names CERT-MU as the national CERT, responsible for handling and coordinating incidents of national significance, and records that CERT-MU assisted Zambia's CERT in 2017.
